title: 5 Biblical Tests for God’s Voice
hook: Five quick tests to know if it’s God—or just your thoughts.
script: Test it by Scripture like the Bereans in Acts 17:11. God won’t contradict His Word. Look for Christlike fruit: love, joy, peace, patience from Galatians 5. If it births bitterness, it’s not Him. Follow peace, not pressure. Colossians 3:15 says let Christ’s peace rule like an umpire. Seek wise counsel. Proverbs 15:22 says plans fail without advisors. Watch providence. Revelation 3:8—He opens doors no one can shut. Slow down, breathe, and ask, Lord, order my steps and guard my motives. He is not hiding. He is guiding, and His voice leads to clarity, not confusion.

title: Is This Job from God? A Real-Time Discernment
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: Say a new job opens across the country. Is it God? Open your Bible first. Does this move clash with clear commands? Acts 17:11. Check the fruit forming in you. Are love, joy, and patience growing, or only pride and panic? Galatians 5. Listen for peace, not a ticking clock. Colossians 3:15. Ask two mature believers for honest counsel. Proverbs 15:22. Then watch the doors. Are obstacles easing in unexpected ways? Revelation 3:8. When Word, fruit, peace, counsel, and providence align, step forward. If they don’t, wait. Obedience today makes guidance tomorrow clearer.

title: Stop Overthinking: A 30-Second God-Filter
script: Here’s a simple filter to hear God without spiraling. Word first: if it disagrees with Scripture, it’s not Him. Fruit next: does this nudge make you kinder and more self-controlled? Galatians 5. Peace check: pressure shouts, the Shepherd leads. Colossians 3:15. Counsel check: wise voices add light, not noise. Proverbs 15:22. Providence check: forcing doors exhausts you; God’s timing opens them. Revelation 3:8. If three or more lights turn red, pause. If they glow green, move humbly. Breathe and say, Father, align my desires with Your will. Guide my next right step. I trust Your pace more than my plan.
